001package guiLessons;
002
003import java.nio.file.Files;
004import java.nio.file.Path;
005import applicationMain.FoundationsMain;
006import entityClasses.User;
007import javafx.application.Platform;
008import javafx.scene.Scene;
009import javafx.scene.control.Label;
010import javafx.scene.input.KeyCode;
011import javafx.scene.layout.StackPane;
012import javafx.stage.Stage;
013
014/**
015 * <p>Title: LessonManualTesting Class.</p>
016 * <p>Description: Opens an isolated contributor page for the manual procedures in
017 * ContributorTests_Javadocs/ManualTests.md. F12 saves the visible lesson scene.
018 * Reuse the same test home on successive launches to check persistence.</p>
019 * <p>MT-01 checks create/read; MT-02 checks update and optional experience;
020 * MT-03 checks deletion and the empty list; MT-04 checks selected subsets;
021 * MT-05 checks input boundaries and helpful errors; MT-06 checks persistence
022 * after restart; MT-07 checks scrolling and large subsets; MT-08 checks Back.
023 * These procedures exercise Task 3's entities through Task 4's real MVC page.
024 * The tester records observed results in ManualTests.md; opening the launcher
025 * alone is not a completed manual test.</p>
026 * <p>MT-09 through MT-13 check ownership, field and whole locks, restricted
027 * additions, repeated experience history, and other-role edits/deletions.
028 * Set contributor.test.actor to owner (101), other (102), admin (999), or
029 * regression (0). Switching actors requires closing and relaunching the fixture;
030 * this is a test identity selection, not application authentication.</p>
031 */
032public final class LessonManualTesting {
033
034        /** Prevents instantiation of the launcher. */
035        private LessonManualTesting() { }
036
037        /**
038         * Launches the manual fixture with a return page and owner ID zero.
039         * @param args unused; storage and evidence paths use contributor.test properties
040         * @throws Exception if the isolated storage directory cannot be created
041         */
042        public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
043                Path testHome = Path.of(System.getProperty("contributor.test.home", "ContributorTests_Javadocs/.work/manual-database"));
044                Files.createDirectories(testHome);
045                // Keep manual test accounts and lessons separate from normal application data.
046                System.setProperty("user.home", testHome.toAbsolutePath().toString());
047                Platform.startup(() -> {
048                        try {
049                                FoundationsMain.database.connectToDatabase();
050                                Stage stage = new Stage();
051                                stage.setScene(new Scene(new StackPane(new Label("Manual test return page")), 800, 600));
052                                stage.setTitle("Manual test home");
053                                // MT-01 through MT-07 use the same real contributor controls as the application.
054                                String role = System.getProperty("contributor.test.actor", "owner");
055                                boolean privileged = role.equals("admin");
056                                int ownerId = privileged ? 999 : role.equals("other") ? 102 : role.equals("regression") ? 0 : 101;
057                                ViewLessons.displayLessons(stage, new User("Manual " + role, "", "", "", "", "", "",
058                                                privileged, !privileged, false, ownerId));
059                                stage.getScene().setOnKeyPressed(event -> {
060                                        // F12 records actual visible state; it does not infer a pass or fail.
061                                        if (event.getCode() == KeyCode.F12) {
062                                                try {
063                                                        Path evidence = Path.of(System.getProperty("contributor.test.evidence", "ContributorTests_Javadocs/screenshots"));
064                                                        LessonTestEvidence.capture(stage.getScene().getRoot(), evidence.resolve("manual-" + System.currentTimeMillis() + ".png"));
065                                                } catch (Exception failure) {
066                                                        failure.printStackTrace();
067                                                }
068                                        }
069                                });
070                                stage.setOnHidden(event -> {
071                                        // MT-06 needs an orderly database close before the next launch reads the file.
072                                        FoundationsMain.database.closeConnection();
073                                });
074                        } catch (Exception failure) {
075                                failure.printStackTrace();
076                                Platform.exit();
077                                System.exit(1);
078                        }
079                });
080        }
081}
